name: Metzali, Tower of Triumph
description: Tower in Orazca containing the Sanctum of the Sun, where the Immortal Sun rested.

timeline.summary: Kumena reaches the Sanctum of the Sun but is bested by Vona and Mavren Fein and thrown out of the tower, then saved by Tishana.
timeline.quote: he was saved in time by his former teacher, Tishana

timeline.summary: A brawl erupts in the chamber and everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: everyone scrambled to touch the Immortal Sun

timeline.summary: Vona and Mavren Fein overpower Kumena and throw him from the Tower of Triumph.
timeline.quote: They quickly threw him out of the window of the Tower of Triumph.
